name: settleview_recorder_coverage

query_condition.sql: SELECT recorder, min(value) AS v FROM "settleview_recorder_coverage" GROUP BY recorder HAVING min(value) < 0.98

description: Research recording incomplete (under 98% of the last 24 h's 5m windows).

context_attributes.slo: 98% of 288 five-minute windows recorded per 24 h.
